description: Canonical S.C.A.L.E. model and provider policy. This file contains no credentials and never replaces a user's Codex catalog or provider configuration.

providers.update_policy: Discover the locally installed catalog; update approved IDs only after validation and a focused benchmark.
Configure the provider and credential locally, then add the exact exposed ID here and validate it before routing work.

Keep the Go API key in OpenCode's credential store. Discover the live model list with `opencode models opencode-go`; route only the explicitly approved, externally executed work orders below. Do not add this provider to Codex's model catalog.

models.use: isolated simple code and routine bounded work
medium-complexity code and bounded multi-file integration
external read-only exploration, documentation, and isolated low-risk work through OpenCode Go; never an authority for critical decisions or global promotion
candidate external standard-code backend; keep disabled until a focused OpenCode Go benchmark passes

routes.boundary: One isolated, low-risk change with explicit acceptance tests.
Ordinary multi-file implementation or bounded integration.
Cross-cutting, security-sensitive, concurrent, or otherwise high-impact work.
Read-only repository mapping, bounded diagnosis, retrieval, and documentation. Produce evidence and a compact handoff; do not modify files or decide critical design.
An explicitly approved, isolated low-risk patch with focused tests. Interactive permission approval is required; benchmark the Go path before making it a default code lane.

change_protocol: Add or update a provider/model here without credentials.
Configure a Codex external provider only in the user's Codex configuration and credential store; configure an external CLI provider in that tool's credential store.
Run the registry validator against the local Codex catalog and provider configuration, plus `--opencode` for an OpenCode Go runtime check when installed.
Benchmark a candidate before making it a route default.
Update the exact routed profiles, validate, QA, and promote through Git.
